🎥🎬: The Further Mis-Adventures of Cliff Booth (2026)

Cliff Booth is back, and Hollywood has become a much more dangerous place. Set in 1977, eight years after the events of Once Upon a Time… in Hollywood, Brad Pitt reprises his role as the fearless stuntman who has now reinvented himself as a Hollywood fixer.

But when a job involving a famous television star pulls him into a world of gangsters, murder, extortion, and blackmail, Cliff discovers that solving Hollywood’s problems can be just as dangerous as performing a death-defying stunt. This time, he’s not working on a movie set. He’s dealing with the real thing.

Directed by David Fincher and written by Quentin Tarantino.
